source_documents.title: Tuning the dual emission of keto/enol forms of excited-state intramolecular proton transfer (ESIPT) emitters via intramolecular charge transfer (ICT)

reference_evidence_units.quote: Both 6c and 6d in toluene exhibit two emission bands, ranging from 400 nm to 500 nm and from 500 nm to 650 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6c, 6d

reference_evidence_units.quote: the energy differences both S1(enol)→TS* and S1(keto)→TS* are small
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6c
reference_evidence_units.statement: Small forward and reverse barriers: enol/keto equilibrium.

reference_evidence_units.quote: These results suggest that the excited-state enol forms of 6a and 6c possess the character of hybridized local and charge-transfer (HLCT) excited state
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6a, 6c
reference_evidence_units.statement: Enol emission of 6a and 6c is HLCT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: However, the excited-state keto forms of 6b and 6c as well as both enol and keto forms of 6d are not of the HLCT character.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6b, 6c, 6d
reference_evidence_units.statement: Keto forms (6b, 6c) and both forms of 6d are not HLCT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Hence, both 6a and 6c do not possess thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) characteristics
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6a, 6c
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 77 K to RT decays, degassed toluene
reference_evidence_units.statement: No long-lived component or O2 quenching: no TADF.

reference_evidence_units.quote: indicating that the RISC from T3 (enol) to S1 (enol) may take place
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6c

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The enol emission of 6c is HLCT; the keto form is not.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Dual enol/keto emission from a reversible ESIPT equilibrium.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: High-lying RISC is proposed from calculated levels; TADF is excluded.

contrast_group.paper_difference: Substituent placement selects enol-only (6a), keto-only (6b) or dual enol/keto emission (6c, 6d).
